frames.title: Align creative ambition with executable workflow
frames.summary: A workflow is healthy when decisions, approvals, assets, and handoffs support the intended result without hidden chaos.
principles: Define deliverables, owners, and approval points before heavy execution.
Keep source of truth visible so departments do not invent parallel states.
Translate creative intent into concrete references, constraints, and next actions.
Prefer reversible experiments before irreversible commitments.
patterns: Use checklists at handoff boundaries to preserve context and continuity.
Document assumptions when a workflow depends on external timing or availability.
antiPatterns: Do not start production with unresolved ownership of key decisions.
Do not hide workflow debt behind informal memory or chat history alone.
